text:
maria_pm: quick sync — we're framing the multi-region / multi-tenant isolation work for Q3. Need to finalize launch criteria, must-have vs nice-to-have, dependencies, and migration plan. @sara_arch @ajay_eng @tom_sales @lee_sre @kate_prod can we get quick notes here? :wave:

sara_arch: added a short sketch in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example-doc (see 'isolation surfaces' section). major tradeoffs: hard isolation (physical) vs logical (routing + rate limits). prefer phased approach.

ajay_eng: agree phased. technical unknown: KV cache invalidation across regions. If we do strict tenant routing, cache warms per-region and cost doubles. short note:
```
if region_miss:
  fetch_kv()
  prime_local_cache()
```
we can optimize with cross-region prefix cache but adds complexity.

tom_sales: two enterprise pilots (FinCorp, HealthAI) want geo-complete isolation + audit logs. They're willing to sign for reserved capacity but need date commitment.

lee_sre: we need SLOs per-tenant-region. suggest baseline: 99.9% p99 latency, error < 0.1%. also need runbook for cross-region evict/failover. storage/egress costs need estimation.

kate_prod: rollout proposal: 3-phase — pilot (single customer per region), soft-launch (subset of traffic + canary), GA (opt-in). gating metrics: latency, error, cost delta, customer QA signoff.

sara_arch: acceptance checklist (draft):
- tenant pinning enforced
- routing policy tests (unit+integration)
- KV cache size & eviction tests
- cross-region failover exercised
- audit logs available
- documented migration path

ajay_eng: dependency list: Dedicated capacity sizing, routing policy DSL, console controls for pinning, telemetry hooks. ETA for prototypes: 6w if no blockers.

tom_sales: customer asks prioritized: 1) geo isolation + audit 2) SLA on latency 3) contract for reserved capacity.

lee_sre: ops notes: need a canary plan that includes traffic shaping and rollback criteria. also capacity buffer 20% for cold-starts.

maria_pm: ok next steps — @sara_arch update doc with acceptance checklist and rough effort estimates. @ajay_eng prototype routing DSL for pinning. @kate_prod draft launch plan + canary metrics. @tom_sales share customer deadlines. i'll sync with finance on cost assumptions. follow-up tomorrow 11am. :calendar: \n
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: infra/simulations -> staging at 2026-07-12T15:20:00Z :robot_face:

maria_pm: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
